briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, we saw multiple developments in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota. A St. Paul business owner was charged with $4M in fraud, and new charges were filed in a $46M scheme involving parents faking autism in children to earn kickbacks. Additionally, the founder of Feeding Our Future was sentenced to over 41 years in prison for $250M in COVID-19 child meals fraud. These cases indicate a larger organized crime scheme and a need for further investigation. We are tracking the individuals and companies involved, and exploring potential connections between them. The Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases and the Feeding Our Future case are two of the most significant investigations currently underway. We will continue to monitor these cases and provide updates as more information becomes available.
